decks.notes: The key idea behind this deck is to create a powerful combo by cycling creatures with high converted mana costs and casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. This is achieved by using cards like Architects of Will, Street Wraith, Curator of Mysteries, and Striped Riverwinder to cycle through the deck and fill the graveyard. Violent Outburst is used to cascade into Living End, while Force of Negation provides protection. Waker of Waves and Generous End allow for disruption and additional cycling, adding to the combo potential.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to quickly bring down the opponent's life total. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Terminate and Fatal Push to efficiently deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of Blood Moon can also catch opponents off guard and hinder their mana base. Overall, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain tempo to secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and resources through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional value and synergy with the deck's creature cards. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for spells and abilities. The goal is to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent, building towards a strong late-game win condition.

This deck focuses on using Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana to play Primeval Titan and quickly assemble the combo of bouncing lands with bounce lands to create more mana and tutor for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By utilizing cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck aims to ramp and establish a powerful board presence, culminating in a win condition of overwhelming the opponent with massive creatures and lands. The main goal is to efficiently assemble the necessary pieces to set up lethal attacks or combos.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get out Puresteel Paladin and Colossus Hammer to create a powerful combo, aided by cards like Sigarda's Aid and Stoneforge Mystic. The deck also includes protective cards like Shadowspear, Kaldra Compleat, and Giver of Runes to keep the combo safe. The deck utilizes artifacts like Springleaf Drum and Urza's Saga to ramp up and generate value. With efficient card draw and protection spells like Spell Pierce, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful, fast-paced strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly cycle through the deck using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to get the combo pieces in hand. The goal is to cast Living End, which will then bring back all the creatures from the graveyard, overwhelming the opponent with a board full of powerful creatures. The deck also includes cards like Grief and Generous End to disrupt the opponent's hand and board, allowing for a smoother combo execution. The deck aims to win the game through a quick and explosive combo play.

The deck focuses on assembling UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana in order to cast powerful colorless spells such as Karn Liberated, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and All Is Dust. It also includes cards like Relic of Progenitus and Expedition Map for control and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a dominant board presence and overwhelming them with powerful threats. This deck utilizes the synergy between the UrzaTron lands and colorless spells to control the game and win through sheer power and resilience.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with the Rakdos color combination. The key concept of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent, utilizing low-cost removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to control the board. It also aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Burning Inquiry. The deck includes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to deal significant damage. The deck also utilizes graveyard mechanics with cards like Waste Not and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse for additional advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with sacrifice and enter-the-battlefield abilities to generate value and create a versatile toolbox of creatures. By utilizing cards such as Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can search for specific creatures to fit the situation and combo off with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a variety of threats and synergies while also maintaining a strong board presence through efficient creature plays and sacrificing for value.

This deck focuses on assembling the three Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. By utilizing cards like Sylvan Scrying and Expedition Map, the deck aims to find and play powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Sundering Titan. Control elements such as Oblivion Stone, Relic of Progenitus, and Karn, the Great Creator help to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also providing additional win conditions. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion for additional flexibility in deck building.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through efficient mana ramp and powerful colorless threats by utilizing the UrzaTron lands. The deck aims to assemble the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly and play powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine, Karn, the Great Creator, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Relic of Progenitus and Oblivion Stone to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the game until the big threats can win the game.

The key strategy of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with low-cost and evasive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. Additionally, disruption through cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate helps control the pace of the game. The deck also utilizes graveyard interactions with cards like Grief and Seasoned Pyromancer, while leveraging Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect key creatures and generate value. Blood Moon can disrupt opponent's mana base, while Orcish Bowmasters provides additional removal. Overall, the deck focuses on pressuring the opponent quickly while disrupting their strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with low-cost and efficient burn spells while deploying fast creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. It aims to deal consistent damage and apply pressure early in the game to close out the match before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also includes cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack to protect against lifegain strategies, while cards like Roiling Vortex disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from gaining life. This aggressive approach is meant to secure a swift victory in a 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through interaction spells and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. The goal is to slow down the opponent's strategy, while generating card advantage and value through card draw and land recursion. Omnath, Locus of Creation acts as a versatile threat and mana fixer, while Leyline Binding and Solitude provide removal options. The deck also includes some powerful late-game finishers like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Nissa, Resurgent Animist.Overall, the deck aims to establish board control and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's hand and resources. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil to strip the opponent's hand while also using cards like Burning Inquiry and Waste Not to generate card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Lightning Bolt and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to deal consistent damage and apply pressure. Additionally, the deck incorporates the Underworld Breach and Raven's Crime combo to continuously disrupt the opponent and control the board. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggression and disruption to gain an advantage.

This deck focuses on casting fast, efficient burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. It includes powerful creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear to apply pressure early on, along with spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Boros Charm to finish the game. The deck also enjoys a good amount of flexibility with cards like Skullcrack and Searing Blaze to disrupt opponent's strategies. Overall, this deck aims to win the game through aggressive and direct damage, without relying on complex combos or long game plans.
